rows.title: TRUNK-6512: Introduce ConceptReferenceRangeContext API
rows.excerpt:
onceptService.getConceptReferenceRange(ConceptReferenceRangeContext)` resolves a range from that context, and the selection algorithm now lives in `ConceptServiceImpl` where the rest of the concept logic is, instead of in a validator. Criteria expressions can use `$context` alongside the existing `$patient`, `$obs`, `$encounter`, `$date`, and `$fn`, and `$date` now reflects the context's date rather than always coming from an Obs.

## How

- New `api/src/main/java/org/openmrs/ConceptReferenceRangeContext.java`, with constructors for `(Person, Concept, Date)`, `(Obs)`, and `(Encounter, Concept)`.
- `ConceptService`/`ConceptServiceImpl` gain the `ConceptReferenceRangeContext` overload; `ConceptReferenceRangeUtility` gains `evaluateCriteria(String, ConceptReferenceRangeContext)`.
- The existing `evaluateCriteria(String, Obs)` and `getConceptReferenceRange(Person, Concept)` signatures are kept and now delegate to the context-based versions, matching what 2.8.x does.
- `getReferenceRange`, `getDefaultReferenceRange`, and `findStrictestReferenceRange` move from `ObsValidator` into `ConceptServiceImpl`. `ObsValidator.getReferenceRange(Obs)` is public API `@since 2.7.0`, so it stays as a delegating shim over the service rather than being deleted — existing callers keep working.
- `@since` tags read `3.0.0, 2.9.0, 2.8.5, 2.7.10`. The `2.7.9` in master/2.8.x/2.9.x is not accurate for this branch: 2.7.9 released on 2026-04-10 without this change, so `2.7.10` is the first 2.7.x release that will actually contain it. (The `2.7.9` tags on the other branches are wrong for the same reason and are worth a separate follow-up.)
- Tests corresponding to the 2.8.x ones are ported into `ConceptServiceImplTest`. `ConceptReferenceRangeUtilityTest` is byte-identical between 2.7.x and 2.8.x and is untouched.

One behaviour change rides along with that delegation: because `evaluateCriteria(String, Obs)` now builds a `ConceptReferenceRangeContext` from the `Obs`, it inherits 2.8.x's requirement that a concept be present. A patient-only criteria expression evaluated against a concept-less `Obs` therefore throws `IllegalArgumentException: concept is required` here, where 2.7.x previously returned a result. That parity with 2.8.x and master was chosen deliberately, rather than keeping the legacy overload lenient on 2.7.x only.
